messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social conditions and indicators, Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, and Elections in Germany during the 1990s, matching this research need: Survey data on attitudes toward democracy and market economy in Germany, political system performance, reunification, party preference, future political expectations, life satisfaction, and demographic characteristics around the Federal Republic’s 50th anniversary.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS 50 Jahre Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1999 survey democracy market economy future expectations life satisfaction reunification
ZA study 50 years Federal Republic Germany 1999 political attitudes democracy market economy survey dataset
